claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Stage 27J remains attribution evidence only; direct carrier/eraser scaling did not establish held-out likelihood steering beyond matched random controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Within Pythia-160M, Stage 27J late-layer carrier and eraser covers can be used as an output-side intervention surface that shifts readable-prefix semantic likelihood margins on held-out rows beyond matched random controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim complete circuits, exact model-wide causal explanation, durable weight edits, open-ended generation control, cross-model steering, or raw CAS-symbol understanding from Stage 27K.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27K is bounded late-layer intervention steering over Pythia-160M CPL2 likelihood margins. It is not weight editing, not complete circuit discovery, not model-wide control, not cross-model control, and not visible free-form generation control.

formal_anchor: Output-side component intervention: scale the late component contributions that Stage 27J identified at the exact prediction positions used by the CPL2 continuation objective.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 readable-prefix source PASS and Stage 27J output-side attribution PASS are both verified.
gates.name: source_contracts

gates.criterion: Evaluation uses the recreated Stage 27J held-out rows only.
gates.name: held_out_split

gates.criterion: Combined carrier amplification plus eraser suppression increases held-out readable-prefix likelihood margin more than matched random combined interventions on at least 60% of rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: combined_steering_eval

gates.criterion: Combined intervention has positive mean margin increment and positive increment share at least 55%.
gates.name: positive_effect_floor

gates.criterion: Carrier polarity flip reduces held-out margin more than matched random carrier flip on at least 60% of rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: carrier_polarity_control

method: Commit this pre-registration and runner before any Stage 27K GPU result is generated.
Verify the Stage 7 readable-prefix source PASS and Stage 27J output-side attribution PASS source contract.
Recreate the Stage 27J learn/eval split deterministically and evaluate only the held-out eval rows.
Load the Stage 27J carrier and eraser covers; do not relearn covers in Stage 27K.
Score readable-prefix CPL2 margins with no intervention.
Score carrier amplification, eraser suppression, and combined carrier-amplification-plus-eraser-suppression at continuation prediction positions.
Score matched random combined interventions with the same cover sizes and component matching policy.
Use carrier polarity flip as a destructive-control diagnostic.
motivation: Stage 27J found late output-side carrier and eraser components for readable-prefix likelihood margins. Stage 27K tests whether those attributed covers are usable as a direct intervention surface: amplify carriers, suppress erasers, and compare the held-out margin lift against matched random interventions.

required_inputs.random_control_policy: same layer/kind when available; singleton MLP blocks fall back to same-kind different-layer controls
